mechanismOfAction.summary: Sodium channel blocker (local anesthesia) + weaker DAT inhibitor than cocaine; tropane alkaloid naturally occurring in some Erythroxylum species.
mechanismOfAction.description: Descarbomethoxycocaine; pseudotropine benzoate. Na-channel block provides local anesthetic activity. DAT inhibition weaker than cocaine. Naturally occurs in some Erythroxylum species; documented as a street-cocaine cutting agent and contaminant. Ester structure → rapid hydrolysis by plasma esterases; short-acting. No formal human PK study. Cocaine analogue control applies in most jurisdictions.
